node_definition.done_when:
Since 2026-10-03T19:10Z, every one of the 115 promoted dispatches carrying a picker_selection had route_mode "explicit". The caller named the lane (--local, --backend, or a review dispatch), so the picker ran only as a shadow. Yet each of those shadow picks sits on the dispatch's critical path: the median recorded latency_ms is 4,181 ms (p90 4,720) on 2026-10-04, while the Jev call itself is 465 ms. Picks that the picker route makes itself run in about 0.8 s, because their inputs are prebuilt. So nearly every dispatch pays about 4 s for a pick whose result does not choose its lane.

Required: an explicit-lane or deterministic dispatch must not wait on its shadow pick. Keep recording the shadow selection, because it is the comparison data the outcome report uses. Move it off the critical path: run it after the worker launches, in the dispatcher process or a short detached step bounded by the existing 5 s bound, and write the selection onto the run pointer, from where promotion carries it to the ledger row. Alternatively, build its inputs with the same fast prebuilt helper the picker route uses; choose by measurement. A picker-routed dispatch keeps its pick before launch. Measure the dispatch wall time to launch for an explicit --local dispatch before and after, 5 dry-run or fixture runs each, in a fresh process, and record both in docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/shadow-pick-off-critical-path.html. A test must assert that an explicit-lane dispatch returns without waiting on a deliberately slow picker client, and that the shadow selection still reaches the run pointer and the ledger row afterwards. In reckon/crew/dispatch.py, edit only the picker call block and the shadow-recording path; a concurrent node edits that file's preflight and headroom region.

Gate: the new test file tests/test_shadow_pick_off_critical_path.py, tests/test_picker*.py, tests/test_dispatch_speed.py, tests/test_routing_explicit_lane_implies_deterministic.py and tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py. Run them with the main checkout's .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 in the FOREGROUND, with one log for base and one for head under the run directory, each ending in an EXIT line, judged by delta.
node_definition.goal: An explicit-lane dispatch never waits on its shadow pick
